patient_identity.statement: V-20, Family1; female7y, RRT since5y, peritoneal dialysis.

genotype.statement: Homozygous NM_014920.5:c.1664_1665delAT p.Tyr555Cysfs*48; Sanger-confirmed shared allele in all5.

segregation.statement: Available relatives show affected homozygotes, unaffected heterozygous/WT relatives and heterozygous parents; family linkage supports recessive inheritance.
limitations: Detailed each-relative Sanger/pedigree pixels in Figure1A/S3 not inspected. Four cases in one pedigree and shared19Mb haplotype across both families limit independence.

phase.statement: Homozygous allele, not a two-variant phase claim. Consanguinity and parental heterozygosity reported.
limitations: Underlying trace/pedigree pixels unreviewed.

causal_confidence.statement: Five affected cases with founder allele,19Mb shared haplotype and recessive segregation; direct patient1 fibroblast defects and WT-CILK1 rescue support the association. This is the donor for the functional experiments.
limitations: One human cellular donor and related founder cohort; no independent variant allelic series for CED.
Kinase activity not assayed for this variant; preserved activity inferred from other variants.
Rescue ciliation remains below control (supplement Fisher p=.0035); cilia length normalized. No clinical therapy tested.
Worm localization retained; new variant IFT74 abnormality described as unpublished/unrescued in Results, while Discussion more broadly invokes elongated cilia/retrograde impairment.
Source correspondence is not clinical proof.
